0.name: TEXT_REGUNI5REAHTAHRA_00758_FOHLOLOH_000_000
0.description: Hmm... Thou art unlike the others─this place ill befits thee. Do not tarry overlong...

5.name: TEXT_REGUNI5REAHTAHRA_00758_FOHLOLOH_000_010
5.description: The telling of my tale alters not its course. If thou knowest my brethren once ruled these skies, will our kingdom return? Should I boast that I was first among our hunters, will the comrades I failed live again?

6.name: TEXT_REGUNI5REAHTAHRA_00758_FOHLOLOH_000_011
6.description: Nay. Once, I lived, and now I await the coming oblivion. Nothing more.

7.name: TEXT_REGUNI5REAHTAHRA_00758_FOHLOLOH_000_020
7.description: This? This is not our home. To our home did come the metal demons, who of life and joy scoured it clean.

8.name: TEXT_REGUNI5REAHTAHRA_00758_FOHLOLOH_000_021
8.description: These are mere bones, and among them do we rest our wings forevermore.

9.name: TEXT_REGUNI5REAHTAHRA_00758_FOHLOLOH_000_022
9.description: Leave us now to our mourning, traveler. Thou wilt find no solace here.

10.name: TEXT_REGUNI5REAHTAHRA_00758_FOHLOLOH_000_023
10.description: Yet now, I sense a stirring... Passions that should no longer live within this tomb...
